name: MindStudio
tagline: No-code platform to build and deploy AI agents anywhere.
description: MindStudio is a no-code platform for designing, building, and deploying AI agents. You assemble agents visually and ship them to web apps, browser extensions, email triggers, scheduled automations, APIs, and MCP servers, with optional custom JavaScript or Python for advanced steps. It connects 1,000+ apps and gives access to 200+ AI models through one interface, charging model usage at provider cost with no markup.
insight: From GoMeta (the team behind the Koji creator platform, ~$36M raised); launched in 2023 as YouAi's MindStudio.

modelSupport.notes: 200+ models through one interface; no per-provider API keys needed.

edge: Build an agent once and deploy it to web, browser extension, email, API, or MCP — across 200+ models with no markup on model usage costs.
pros: Optional custom JS or Python steps
Ships agents as APIs and MCP servers
cons: Usage billing on top of subscription
Free tier limited to one agent

references.title: Meet YouAI's MindStudio, an AI App Developer Platform
